significance: A hilltop Shakta pitha above Sitakunda near Chittagong where Hindu tradition holds that the right arm of Sati fell. It is one of the 51 consecrated shrines linked to the myth of Sati's dismemberment and a major pilgrimage destination in Bangladesh.
story: Shiva is said to have carried Sati's body across the world in a tandava of grief until Vishnu cut it apart with his Sudarshana Chakra, sanctifying every place where a fragment came to rest.
